'''Vylla Tendeil''' was a beguiling<ref name="TLJ Companion">[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi The Official Movie Companion|''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'' The Official Movie Companion]]</ref> [[Gender|female]] [[Vylla Tendeil's species|alien]] who spent time in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]<ref name="TLJ" /> in around [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] to [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] takes place immediately after the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it must also take place in approximately 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].</ref> As the [[Resistance]] agents [[Rose Tico]] and [[Finn]] made their way through the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] [[Mission to Canto Bight|in search]] of the [[Master Codebreaker]], Tendeil stood conversing with a [[human]] patron of the [[casino]] next to a [[musician]]. She had [[Color|brown]] skin and wore a [[Color|white]] [[Clothing|dress]] with a golden bracelet.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vylla Tendeil first appeared in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> and was first identified in the [[2018]] magazine ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi The Official Movie Companion]]''.<ref name="TLJ Companion" /> Concept art for the character titled "Flatish 01" was drawn by creature concept designer [[Tim Napper]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
